question: Can parameterized mechanisms bind correctly over real HTTP when using endpoint-appropriate unseen IDs that exist on jsonplaceholder.typicode.com, thereby resolving V1_HTTP_DESIGN_IMPOSSIBLE_IDS from the parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID experiment?
hypothesis: With valid unseen IDs (posts 96-98, users 8-10, comments postId 5-7), distill_parameterized with Fix1+Fix2+Fix3 will achieve 9/9 HTTP binding correctness, demonstrating that parameterized mechanisms execute correctly over real HTTP. The literal baseline will also achieve 9/9, confirming the improvement is from corrected test design not parameterization advantage.
falsifier: HTTP binding accuracy < 1.0 on valid IDs, or URL construction accuracy < 1.0, or B_LITERAL achieves higher HTTP accuracy than parameterized mechanisms.

baselines.description: Literal mechanisms (zero-parameter) with same training data and valid IDs. Expected: 9/9 HTTP execution success. Serves as reachability control to distinguish binding errors from API data limits.

Unfixed heuristic (without Fix3) applied to protocol-only URLs. Expected: unfixed produces slot_count > 0 while fixed produces 0, demonstrating Fix3 necessity. Uses URL pair where Fix2 passes but Fix3 should reject.

positive_control.description: Parameterized mechanisms with valid IDs on jsonplaceholder.typicode.com. Expected: 9/9 HTTP execution success (status 200, valid JSON body matching expected resource type).

null_control.description: Request to non-existent resource ID 999999 on each endpoint. Expected: 404 or empty array without crashes. Validates error handling.

measurement_validity: distill_parameterized + Fix1+Fix2+Fix3 restored from parent execute commit a49d839e into src/spider/kernel.py; kernel regression tests pass before HTTP testing

Unseen IDs are endpoint-appropriate and verified to exist BEFORE HTTP binding test: posts 96-98 (jsonplaceholder has posts 1-100), users 8-10 (jsonplaceholder has users 1-10), comments postId 5-7 (returns data for any postId 1-100)

Comment body validation accepts list-of-dicts with keys postId,id,name,email,body (fixes V2_COMMENT_BODY_VALIDATION_BUG from parent audit); non-empty comment lists marked valid, empty lists marked valid
Token cost measured with tiktoken cl100k_base tokenizer (not chars/4 heuristic); model pricing documented (model name, $/1K tokens, source, date)
HTTP execution uses urllib.request with 10s timeout; validates status=200 and JSON body parsing; raw HTTP logs preserved as derived artifact
GET-only endpoints tested (PUT/POST method conflation not in scope)
Network access to jsonplaceholder.typicode.com required; network failure = infrastructure failure, not scientific falsification
Training observations use same P1_API_ENDPOINTS structure as parent (fetch_posts 5 obs with GET+PUT shared, fetch_users 3 obs, fetch_comments 3 obs)
decision_rule: C1: URL binding accuracy >= 1.0 (9/9 correct URL construction for unseen IDs)
C2: HTTP binding accuracy >= 1.0 (9/9 correct HTTP executions: status 200, valid JSON body matching expected resource type)
C3: B_LITERAL HTTP accuracy >= 1.0 (9/9 literal mechanisms execute correctly over HTTP with valid IDs)

C4: B_UNFIXED protocol-only detection: unfixed slot_count > 0 while fixed slot_count = 0 for protocol-only URL https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/ (demonstrates Fix3 necessity on discriminating data where Fix2 passes)
C5: Kernel regression tests pass (3/3): test_unknown_is_default, test_parameterized_mechanism_binds_only_when_guarded, test_invalidation_forces_abstention
C6: Token cost measured with actual tokenizer; parameterized token count <= literal token count
ALL conditions C1-C6 must pass for SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST; any failure triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING
product_consequence_positive: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances from MEASUREMENT_INVALID to EXPERIMENTAL with real HTTP binding evidence on valid IDs. URL construction correctness 1.0 confirmed. HTTP binding correctness 9/9 demonstrated. Claim ceiling expands from 'synthetic single-slot GET URL construction' to 'committed-code synthetic single-slot GET with real HTTP binding on jsonplaceholder'. C-PRODUCT-ECON gets first actual tokenization data point. Product viability signal strengthened.
product_consequence_negative: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains blocked on real HTTP binding. If HTTP accuracy < 9/9 even with valid IDs, there is a genuine binding or execution bug beyond test design. C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS. No product promotion.
estimated_cost: Low: 18 HTTP requests to jsonplaceholder.typicode.com (9 parameterized + 9 literal), 3 null control requests, 3 kernel regression tests, 1 tiktoken measurement. No browser automation, no model calls, no network beyond jsonplaceholder.
expected_information_gain: High: resolves the primary blocker (V1_HTTP_DESIGN_IMPOSSIBLE_IDS) from parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID experiment. If C1-C3 pass, provides first real HTTP evidence for C-PARAM-INHERIT. If C1-C3 fail, identifies genuine binding or execution bug. Either outcome materially changes the C-PARAM-INHERIT claim status.
